Exercise 2
Using the datasets::trees data, complete the following. This question refreshes create a linear model, graphing the linear model, and introduces using some LaTeX expressions on the graph.

2a.

Create a regression model for y = Volume as a function of x = Height.
```{r}
data(trees)
model <- lm(Volume ~ Height, data = trees)
```

2b

Display the summary of the model to view the y-intercept and slope of the regression line.
```{r}
summary(model)
```

2c

Using ggplot2, create a scatter plot of Volume vs Height.
```{r}
ggplot(trees, aes(x=Height, y=Volume))+
  geom_point()
```

2d

Color the scatter using the Girth variable.
```{r}
ggplot(trees, aes(x=Height, y=Volume, color = Girth))+
  geom_point(size = 3)
```

2e

Modify the color scheme using a RColorBrewer palette.
```{r}
ggplot(trees, aes(x=Height, y=Volume, color = Girth))+
  geom_point(size = 3)+
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "magma")
```
